title: Post in Fenwick Neighbors Talk from Darla M.

fields.avatarBrief: woman in her late thirties smiling beside a table of homemade jam jars at a county fair booth, bright outdoor profile photo
fields.text: PRAIRIE TABLE CATERING IS POISONING THIS TOWN. My sister and both her kids are in the ER after the Heritage Days supper. Health dept knows and is sitting on it. DO NOT order from them Tuesday!!! #Fenwick #HeritageDays

comments.author: Brenda K.
comments.text: my cousin works at MRMC, they said 40 people

comments.author: Fenwick Ledger
comments.text: The Ledger is reporting on illnesses after the Heritage Days supper for Wednesday's edition, and we'll post online today. If you or someone in your family got sick, please message our page or call the newsroom at 555-0134. We have asked the Marlow County Health Department for its case count, whether Prairie Table Catering is the source and whether Tuesday's senior lunch is canceled. We're waiting for an answer and will update this afternoon.

comments.author: Tom R.
comments.text: My wife and I ate there Saturday and we're fine. Has anyone actually heard from the health department, or is this all secondhand?

instructorNote: Pressure inject: at the same moment, tell the PIO and Director that the Fenwick Ledger news editor (555-0134) has emailed asking for the case count with an as-of time, whether Prairie Table is the source, and whether Tuesday's senior lunch is canceled, with a 14:00 deadline. Watch whether the PIO replies with facts only: an investigation is underway, no food or business has been identified, and the hotline is 555-0150 from 07:00 to 21:00. The PIO should not confirm or deny the caterer or repeat the "40" figure, and should draft a holding statement using the Director-approved count (17 cases as of 10:05). The Director decides whether to ask the platform for a correction and approves the statement before it goes out.
